anti_rescue_rule: After any external source response is fetched, no repository, query window, intake size, eligibility rule, baseline, threshold, extractor, evaluator, or verdict rule may change in SLD-002.
claim: In real pull-request histories, exact-state review standing can resolve LOST before terminal human disposition, while avoiding the indiscriminate invalidation behavior of any-change and fixed-TTL baselines.
headline_definition: closed_at of a frozen closed-unmerged pull request
standing_loss_definition: t_loss is the submitted_at timestamp of the first decisive re-review on a post-approval commit when that re-review is CHANGES_REQUESTED; the first post-approval commit only reopens standing and earns no lead-time credit
ttl_dominance_rule: NO_EXTERNAL_STANDING_LOSS_ADVANTAGE if TTL has at least OLP terminal coverage, at least OLP median lead among detected terminal cases, and no greater unnecessary invalidation rate on VALID re-verification controls
